description: Parse national or international input using an explicit origin region and emit canonical E.164 plus display formats.
acceptance: R-1: National input requires an origin region while + prefixed input is independently resolvable.
R-2: Tests cover NL, GB, US, invalid, ambiguous, non-geographic, and short-number cases.
verification: uv run ruff check src tests

review_history.evidence: R-1 approved: national input without region raises a typed ambiguity error, while plus-prefixed input resolves independently and ignores locale. R-2 approved: fourteen focused tests cover NL, GB, US, malformed, ambiguous, non-geographic, possible, and short-number behavior; all forty-two repository tests pass.
